top_signals.title: US Readies Tariff Hike on China, EU Goods
top_signals.summary: The US is set to announce plans to raise tariffs on goods from China, the European Union and more than a dozen other economies, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg’s Derek Wallbank has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Jim Cramer says Tuesday's market pullback is an encouraging sign. Here's why
top_signals.summary: Jim Cramer said Tuesday's market action following Monday's massive rally is an encouraging sign that stocks are on the path to a more sustainable recovery.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nscale says it has option to stay private as tech sell-off threatens $35bn IPO
top_signals.summary: Chief executive Josh Payne seeks to reassure staff at the UK data centre group after cutting back on hiring

top_signals.title: Anthropic loses $1 trillion crown as it sinks below IPO price
top_signals.summary: Anthropic lost its $1 trillion market capitalisation on Tuesday after the firm’s shares dropped below their initial public offering price. The Claude maker’s valuation surged to $2 trillion on its public market last week, but its valuation has since sunk to $998.2bn, as investors continue to rotate out of tech stocks following Monday’s blistering rally.
